job_description: To ensure efficient and accountable management of LPG operations, warehouse activities, and inventory control in compliance with organizational policies and safety standards - 50% Oversee the receipt, storage, and dispatch of LPG supplies/ cylinders for FDMNs operations in coordination with the line management, and other relevant stakeholders. Coordinate and track payment requests while resolving procurement and logistics-related payment issues. Track and report stock discrepancies, damages, losses, and expired items, and recommend corrective actions. Maintain proper filing systems for Purchase Requests (PR), Purchase Orders (PO), GRNs/GDNs, invoices, vouchers, and waybills. Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation, reports, and inventory records as required. job_description: JOB DESCRIPTION Society for Health Extension and Development (SHED), a national NGO working in the Cox's Bazar district, is implementing the “ Nutrition Sensitive Food Security Interventions"  Project in Rohingya Refugee Camps in Cox’s Bazar from August 2026 to December 2026, funded by CWW. SHED is looking for qualified candidates for the following positions. CWW FUNDED "NUTRITION-SENSITIVE FOOD SECURITY INTERVENTIONS IN ROHINGYA REFUGEE CAMPS OF COX'S BAZAR" PROJECT Reportable to:  Deputy Director - Health and Nutrition Contract details:  Up to December 2026 with possibility of extension. Job Purpose:  The Programme Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, planning, implementation, coordination, monitoring, budget management, and quality assurance of integrated nutrition-sensitive and food security interventions. The position ensures that project activities are implemented effectively, efficiently, and in compliance with organizational policies, donor requirements, humanitarian standards, and government regulations. The Programme Manager provides technical and managerial leadership to the project team, ensures timely delivery of project outputs, promotes integration between nutrition and food security interventions, and strengthens collaboration with government authorities, donors, sectors, and other stakeholders to achieve sustainable programme outcomes. Liaises with Internally: Project Officer-Agriculturist, MEAL Officer, Finance and Admin Officer, HR, Logistics and Procurement staff, Community Mobilizers, and other programme support teams. Externally: Government authorities (RRRC, CiC, Department of Agricultural Extension, relevant line departments), UN agencies, donors, Nutrition Sector, Food Security Sector, implementing partners, local NGOs, community leaders, and other humanitarian stakeholders. Main Duties and Responsibilities 1. Project Management and Technical Leadership Lead the planning, implementation, supervision, and quality assurance of integrated nutrition-sensitive agriculture and food security interventions in accordance with project objectives, work plans, and donor requirements. Develop detailed implementation plans and ensure timely execution of project activities, including beneficiary selection, support group formation, nutrition education, homestead gardening, climate-smart agriculture, capacity building, and distribution of project inputs. Ensure quality integration of nutrition, food security, and behavior change (SBCC) interventions to improve household food security, dietary diversity, and nutrition outcomes. Provide technical guidance, coaching, and supportive supervision to project staff to ensure high-quality service delivery. Conduct regular field monitoring visits and take corrective actions to address implementation challenges and improve programme quality. 2. Budget and Resource Management Manage the project budget and ensure efficient utilization of financial resources in accordance with approved budgets and donor regulations. Monitor budget utilization, expenditure forecasts, procurement plans, and activity implementation schedules to ensure value for money and timely delivery of project outputs. Work closely with Finance and Procurement teams to ensure timely procurement, distribution, and accountability of project resources. Ensure compliance with organizational financial policies, internal controls, and donor compliance requirements. 3. Coordination and Partnership Establish and maintain effective coordination with government authorities, RRRC, CiC offices, the Department of Agricultural Extension, the Nutrition Sector, the Food Security Sector, UN agencies, implementing partners, and other stakeholders. Represent the organization in coordination meetings, technical working groups, and sector forums, and contribute to technical discussions and knowledge sharing. Strengthen collaboration with relevant stakeholders to ensure complementarity, integration, and effective implementation of project activities. Maintain effective communication with local authorities and communities to facilitate project implementation and obtain required approvals. 4. Human Resource Management Provide leadership, supervision, mentoring, and performance management to project staff to ensure effective implementation of project activities. Identify staff capacity gaps and organize technical training, coaching, and professional development opportunities. Promote teamwork, accountability, safeguarding, staff well-being, and a positive working environment. 5. Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning Ensure effective implementation of the project's MEAL system, including routine monitoring, data quality assurance, beneficiary feedback mechanisms, and performance tracking against project indicators. Review monitoring findings, data analysis, and beneficiary feedback to support adaptive management and continuous programme improvement. Ensure documentation of lessons learned, best practices, innovations, case studies, and success stories to strengthen programme quality and organizational learning. Promote accountability to affected populations by ensuring effective implementation of feedback and complaint mechanisms. 6. Reporting and Documentation Ensure timely preparation and submission of high-quality weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, and donor reports in accordance with agreed reporting schedules. Review project progress against work plans, indicators, and budgets, and provide evidence-based recommendations to improve programme performance. Maintain complete project documentation, including technical reports, monitoring records, distribution documentation, meeting minutes, and donor compliance records. 7. Safeguarding, Compliance and Risk Management Ensure compliance with organizational policies, donor requirements, safeguarding standards, Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA), Code of Conduct, Core Humanitarian Standards (CHS), and relevant government regulations. Promote community participation, transparency, inclusion, and accountability throughout project implementation. Identify programme risks and develop appropriate mitigation measures to ensure effective and compliant project delivery. 8. Other Responsibilities Perform any other duties assigned by the Executive Director or designated supervisor to support organizational objectives.

job_description: WARBE Development Foundation:  WARBE Development Foundation is a non-profit organization working in the field of migration and development in Bangladesh since 1997. WARBE took the pioneering role in Bangladesh as a migrant workers’ association to deal with the issues of migrants’ rights. WARBE has undertaken many development activities at the grassroots and national and international levels to protect the rights, well-being and dignity of migrant workers and their families. As part of this, WARBE DF with support from the Winrock International is implementing the Ashshash (Phase–II) in Dhaka East and Narsingdi which is funded by the Embassy of Switzerland in Bangladesh. PROJECT BACKGROUND: Winrock International – Ashshash (Phase–II), is funded by the Embassy of Switzerland in Bangladesh. The project is supporting human trafficking survivors with sustainable social and economic reintegration into their respective communities, and also providing support-services that ensures their wellbeing and self-sufficiency. The survivors are getting psychosocial counseling support along with other social services, and facilitated opportunities for skills-devolvement and entrepreneurship training. Through which, the economic empowerment of the survivors is also ensured in the forms of wage-based and self-employment, and other income generation opportunities. The main objective of the project is to ensure that “women and men who have escaped trafficking will restore their dignity and wellbeing, and become self-sufficient”. Furthermore, Ashshash will reach people in the project’s working areas; either directly or indirectly, through awareness-raising activities on factors that make people vulnerable to human trafficking, and to ensure the prevention of human trafficking. The Ashshash project is providing comprehensive and personalized packages of service-provision to the survivors of human trafficking in Bangladesh. The project is implemented in ten of the most trafficking-prone areas across the country. POSITION SUMMARY: Project Manager (PM) will work under the direct oversight of WARBE (Ashshash’s Sustainable Reintegration Partner (SRP) across the working districts of Dhaka East & Narsingdi of the project. The PM will work as lead of the Ashshash project at WARBE DF. Leading and managing project activities to ensure their overall sustainable reintegration by building and maintaining a collaborative and interpersonal relationship with service providers will plan and manage the case management process for the survivors. PM will lead the assessment process of contextual needs and demands of each survivor under their management. Through this process, the PMs will identify and plan the provision of relevant psychosocial and social services, career-oriented choices for the economic development of the survivors through training and employment opportunities based on their contextual requirements, in a customized modality. Accordingly, the PMs will demonstrate the advocacy initiatives with the government offices. Also create a strong and effective collaboration and to support National Referral Mechanism (NRM) with local public and private service providers and avail the required services for each survivor. The PMs are also expected to demonstrate ethical engagement and care with the survivors, gender-sensitive methodologies of communication and guidance, and how to provide of trauma-informed support to the survivors. The PMs must also ensure compliance with WARBE and Winrock International’s ‘Code of Conduct’ and ‘Do No Harm Policy’, whilst maintaining privacy and confidentiality of information respective to each survivor. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Lead a Project team and provide professional and technical support to project staff and other stakeholders of Ashshash project; Overall management of project implementation and activities based on the operational plan to achieve project target in time; Ensure that project activities are implemented in time complying with donor requirements; Day-to-day supervise and monitor the activities of project team including social services, economic empowerment, finance and monitoring to ensure effective project implementation; Coordinate the overall case management (identification to reintegration) system of Ashshash; Ensure social protection services to each survivor through need assessment, psychosocial counselling, health and legal support; Secure economic empowerment support to each survivor through comprehensive career counselling, soft skills, skills development, assessment, certification, entrepreneurship training, employment including Wage and Self with follow-up support; Ensure private sector engagement through partnership for sustainable wage and self-employment of the Ashshash beneficiaries; Coordination with other government and non-government service providing organizations to ensure service through referral; Coordination with Government, Local Government, Counterparts, Donors, NGOs, other related stakeholders and Projects; Prepare quarterly and annual narrative report, financial report and variance report; Develop and implement procurement plans and provide audit responses timely and accurately; Actively manage to ensure baseline, mid-line and final evaluation accurately done considering Winrock’s and donor`s requirements; Attend regular basis in Government meeting and other coordination meeting in working districts; Assist to monitor survivors` progress through regular field visits using a prescribed schedule; Monitor program components at field along with training, workshop, meetings at different levels and provide feedback; Organize performance appraisal of staff as per their job description and design necessary action plan for staff development and implement it accordingly; Setup files to ensure that all project information is appropriately documented and secured; Manage survivors’ database and ensure managing of Ashshash MIS with all require data in timely manner; Build and maintain liaison with Local Administration, Law enforcing agency, court and networks in line with human trafficking issues; and Maintain the confidentiality of project document and organizational regulations and implement it at his/her jurisdiction. Other duties, as assigned.

This support will continue as graduates establish and strengthen their schools, creating a growing network of community-led institutions that expand educational opportunities for girls in underserved regions. This is the inaugural session of the Graduate School of Education. As such the program might need to be restructured on the basis of experience and feedback. The first Master's in Teaching cohort is scheduled to begin in January 2027, with graduates expected to establish their schools in January 2029. job_description: Asian University for Women (AUW) located in Chattogram, Bangladesh, is the first of its kind: an independent international institution dedicated to excellence, women’s education and leadership development. Rooted in the aspirations of Asia, while global in outlook, AUW prepares women to become leaders who create meaningful change in their communities and beyond.   Since 2022, the Asian University for Women (AUW) has collaborated with the renowned international institutions to offer a Master of Arts in Education focused on Education policy and leadership. Building on this experience, AUW is now inaugurating an innovative Master of Arts  in Teaching (MAT) program, which endeavours young women to return to their communities as highly-qualified teachers and leaders to  establish  top-tier secondary schools in underutilized local spaces, thereby addressing the hazards of journey to a distant school-an ongoing challenge for many students in underserved communities.  The program will be delivered mostly through a hybrid model in collaboration with leading international universities. Courses will be taught by international faculties via Zoom in a smart classroom environment and will be supported on site by highly qualified Teaching Fellows who will facilitate learning and provide academic guidance.  The program will recruit cohorts of university-educated women who will jointly apply in a group of 5 (five), with a proposal to establish a girls' secondary school in their home community. Throughout the two-year program, participants will refine their proposals while completing intensive coursework in teaching, leadership, curriculum development, and school administration. To accommodate working professionals, students who are currently teaching will have the flexibility to participate online when necessary, with the expectation that they will attend designated on-campus immersion sessions throughout the program.  Upon graduation, the most promising teams will receive seed funding to launch their proposed schools, along with ongoing mentoring and organizational support from AUW. This support will continue as graduates establish and strengthen their schools, creating a growing network of community-led institutions that expand educational opportunities for girls in underserved regions. This is the inaugural session of the Graduate School of Education. As such the program might need to be restructured on the basis of experience and feedback.  The first Master's in Teaching cohort is scheduled to begin in January 2027, with graduates expected to establish their schools in January 2029. The role of the Academic Program Coordinator is pivotal in launching and shaping this graduate program from its inception. The Program Coordinator will support the establishment of the program by coordinating curriculum development, developing academic policies and documentation, facilitating faculty recruitment and onboarding, cultivating strategic partnerships, supporting  quality assurance processes, coordinating with Outreach Coordinator on student recruitment and admissions, and establishing the academic and operational systems required for a successful launch. As the program grows, you will work alongside faculty and students to manage academic procedures, support the effective and sustainable delivery of the curriculum, enhance student learning and success, and contribute to the continued development of a program with the potential to transform women's education throughout the region.  Join one of the nation’s most internationally diverse academic communities, committed to excellence, innovation and social impact! Partnership and Stakeholder Engagement   ● Coordinate and build partnerships with national and international universities.   ● Support the recruitment of qualified instructors and admissions of prospective students.   ● Support recruitment of qualified Teaching Fellows   ● Collaborate with internal departments to ensure seamless program delivery.   Student Support   ● Support graduate students throughout their academic journey including orientation, advising processes and academic progression.   ● Respond to student inquiries and connect students with appropriate academic resources and support.   ● Facilitate communication between students and academic departments.   ● Foster a supportive and inclusive learning environment.  School Proposal and Project Implementation  ● Oversee the educational milestones related to student school development initiatives.  ● Support faculty supervision of student teams as their build and refine their school building and implementation plans.  ● Monitor the advancement of the project and promote teamwork among students, mentors and faculty members.   Qualifications   ● Masters degree in a related field.  ● Minimum 3 years of experience in academic program coordination, educational administration, curriculum development or a related field.   ● Strong understanding of program assessment, accreditation processes and academic policies in higher education.  ● Strong interpersonal and networking skills.  ● Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.  ● Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.   ● Strong analytical, problem solving and decision making skills.   Preferred Qualifications   ● Experience working with schools, NGOs, or higher education institutions.  ● Teaching experience is preferred.   ● Understanding of educational challenges and opportunities in underserved and marginalized communities, in relation to girls’ education.   ● Experience coordinating academic events, workshops or seminars.   ● Familiarity with South Asian educational contexts.

job_description: The Project Coordinator (PC) will be responsible for leading, managing, and ensuring the effective and timely implementation of the Space to Lead Project within Charfesson Upazila, Bhola Sadar & Dhaka South City Corporation. The project coordinator’s base will be Charfesson Upazila. The PC will oversee all aspects of project planning, coordination, implementation, monitoring, reporting, and stakeholder engagement to achieve project goals related to improving sexual and reproductive health and rights among adolescents, youth, women, and marginalized communities. The position requires strong leadership, technical understanding of SRHR, partnership management, quality assurance, and capacity development of staff to ensure the project contributes meaningfully to enhanced SRHR knowledge, access to services, and rights-based practices in urban and rural poor settings. Major Responsibilities Provide overall leadership, direction, and management of the SRHR Project to achieve planned outcomes and deliverables. Strengthen collaboration with government health departments, NGOs/INGOs, youth networks, community-based organizations, and private healthcare providers to maximize project impact and sustainability. Guide and supervise the project team to maintain high performance, accountability, and compliance with organizational and donor standards. Specific Job Responsibilities 1. Planning and Implementation Develop monthly, quarterly, bi-annual, and annual work plans and budgets aligned with SRHR project objectives and donor requirements. Lead the quality and timely implementation of SRHR interventions—awareness sessions, behavior change communication, youth-friendly services, referrals, capacity building, and advocacy initiatives. Oversee procurement of SRHR-related materials (IEC/BCC materials, training resources, supplies) in compliance with organizational and donor policies. Ensure effective coordination with finance, logistics, and administration teams for smooth implementation. 2. Monitoring, Reporting, and Documentation Regularly monitor project activities, outputs, and outcomes, identifying any deviations and addressing them promptly. Prepare high-quality periodic progress reports (monthly, quarterly, bi-annual, annual) capturing achievements, challenges, lessons learned, and innovative practices. Document success stories, case studies, research findings, and best practices relevant to SRHR in urban contexts. Maintain updated monitoring data, service statistics, and program documentation to ensure knowledge management and audit readiness. 3. Stakeholder and Donor Coordination Serve as the primary focal point for donors, government health departments (DGHS, DGFP), city corporations, Upazila and Zila administration, development partners, and local stakeholders. Organize donor visits, joint monitoring missions, and review meetings, and ensure that project achievements are showcased effectively. Build partnerships with health facilities, service providers, youth networks, schools, NGOs, and private sector actors to strengthen SRHR service access and community engagement. 4. Capacity Building and Team Management Provide continuous coaching, mentoring, and technical guidance to field staff, peer educators, volunteers, and partner organizations. Identify capacity gaps and organize relevant training sessions on SRHR, gender, safeguarding, adolescent development, and community engagement. Conduct team meetings and performance reviews to ensure accountability and professional growth. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and gender-sensitive working environment. 5. Quality Assurance and Compliance Ensure all SRHR interventions adhere to organizational policies, donor guidelines, national SRHR standards, and safeguarding protocols. Promote innovative, rights-based approaches that empower adolescents and women to access accurate information and services. Ensure the technical quality of training, IEC/BCC materials, community sessions, and service delivery mechanisms. 6. Advocacy and Community Engagement Lead advocacy efforts with local authorities, community leaders, and service providers to promote SRHR rights, gender equality, and stigma reduction. Support behavior change communication campaigns targeting adolescents, youth, parents, and community influencers. Coordinate community outreach events, health fairs, and awareness campaigns. 7. Emergency and Humanitarian Response Support SRHR-related emergency interventions (menstrual hygiene, GBV mitigation, adolescent protection) during crises, disasters, or public health emergencies. Coordinate with emergency response clusters, health authorities, and humanitarian partners. 8. Other Responsibilities Undertake field visits, coordination meetings, workshops, and relevant fora as required. Perform any other duties assigned by the Senior management.

মাঠ ব্যবস্থাপক ও শাখা ব্যবস্থাপকের জন্য প্রস্তুতকৃত হ্যান্ডবিল নিয়মিত চর্চা করা ও মাঠ পর্যায়ে প্রচারনা চালানো। নিয়মিত মাঠে গিয়ে সঞ্চয় ও ঋণ পাশ বই এবং রেজিষ্টারের সাথে প্রত্যেক সদস্যার সঞ্চয় ও ঋণ হিসাব মিলিয়ে দেখা। সমিতির কোন সদস্য ঋণ খেলাপী হলে সমিতির অন্যান্য সদস্য ও জামিনদারের সহযোগিতা নিয়ে, নিয়মিত সমিতির সদস্যদের সাথে কর্মীদের যোগাযোগে উৎসাহিত করা এবং কর্মীদের সমন্বয়ে টিম গঠনপূর্বক খেলাপী আদায়ে বাস্তবমুখি পদক্ষেপ গ্রহণসহ আপনি নিজেও টিমে যুক্ত হবেন। কর্মীদের মাঝে আন্তঃসম্পর্ক উন্নয়ন, অর্জিত অভিজ্ঞতা, কৌশল ও পদ্ধতি ইত্যাদি বিষয়ে ধারাবাহিকভাবে মতবিনিময় করা। সমিতির প্রতি সদস্যর বাড়ি সরেজমিনে পরিদর্শন এবং সদস্যদের সাথে সম্পর্ক উন্নয়ন করা। অনুরূপ দায়িত্ব পালন প্রতি মাঠ ব্যবস্থাপকের জন্য বাধ্যতামূলক। সংস্থার ঋণ প্রশাসন নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী ঋণ প্রদান ও আদায়, সঞ্চয় আদায় সময়মত ও নিয়ম মাফিক হচ্ছে কিনা তা যাচাই করা। প্রতিমাসের শেষে এরিয়া ম্যানেজারের নিকট পরবর্তী মাসের পরিকল্পনা পেশ করা যাতে বিস্তাারিতভাবে প্রতিদিনের কাজ, সময় ও স্থানের বিবরণ থাকবে। মাঠ পর্যায়ে ঋণ দান কর্মসূচী ও কর্মীদের দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য মনিটরিং ও ঋড়ষষড়ি টঢ় এবং ঋণ কর্মসূচী পরিচালনা ক্ষেত্রে সৃষ্ট সমস্যাসমূহ কর্মী সমন্বয় সভায় যৌথ আলোচনা পূর্বক তাৎক্ষনিকভাবে অতিক্রমের পদক্ষেপ গ্রহণের কলাকৌশল অবলম্বণ করা। মাঠ ব্যবস্থাপকের অনুপস্থিতিতে তার দায়িত্বে পরিচালিত সমিতিসমূহের কালেকশনসহ যাবতীয় দায়িত্ব সাময়িকভাবে আপনার উপর ন্যস্ত থাকবে।  শাখার হিসাব ব্যবস্থাপনা পদ্ধতি ও কলাকৌশল শিখে নেওয়া এবং প্রতিনিয়ত যাচাই করা। আপনি ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কার্যক্রমের যাবতীয় প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত ক্ষেত্রে কম্পিউটার ব্যবহার করবেন এবং শাখার সমস্ত কর্মীর কম্পিউটার ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করবেন। আপনি নিয়মিত সাপ্তাহিক ও মাসিক কর্মী সমন্বয় সভার সভাপতির দায়িত্ব পালন করবেন। কর্মী সমন্বয় সভায় প্রস্তাবিত প্রকল্প যাচাই ও নতুন সদস্য ভর্তি, বকেয়া ঋণি সদস্য, নিস্ক্রিয় সদস্য, পলাতক সদস্য প্রভৃতি বিষয়ে আলোচনা চলমান রাখা এবং মোবাইল ফোনে যোগাযোগ অব্যাহত রাখা। শুধু তাই নয় ইত্যাদি বিষয়ে তাৎক্ষনিকভাবে কার্যকরি ব্যবস্থা গ্রহন করা। কর্মী সমন্বয় সভায় আলোচিত প্রতিটি বিষয়ে আপনার দায়িত্বে রেজুলেশন প্রস্তুত এবং বিষয়টি নিয়মিত ও ধারাবাহিকভাবে চলমান রাখা।  শাখার অফিসিয়াল যাবতীয় ফাইল ও ডকুমেন্ট আপনার ও হিসাবরক্ষকের সার্বক্ষনিক তত্বাবধান ও নজরদারিতে থাকবে।  ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কার্যক্রম সফলভাবে বাস্তবায়নের সুবিধার্থে দৈনিক এবং কর্মী সমন্বয় সভায় বিভিন্ন কৌশল ও পদ্ধতি এবং মতবিনিময় নিয়মিত আলোচনা অব্যাহত রাখা। মাঠে প্রাথমিকভাবে যাচাইকৃত প্রকল্প কর্মী সমন্বয় সভায় আলোচনা ও অনুমোদন ব্যতিত প্রকল্প অনুমোদন করা যাবে না এবং এরিয়া ম্যানেজার ও কেন্দ্রে প্রেরণ করা যাবে না। সমিতির সদস্যদের জন্য সংস্থার অনুমোদন প্রাপ্ত প্রকল্পের শর্ত অনুযায়ী সাপ্তাহিক ও মাসিক কিস্তি মাসের প্রথম হতেই মাসের শেষ সময় পর্যন্ত নিয়মিত কিস্তি আদায়ের চলমান প্রক্রিয়া অব্যাহত রাখতে কর্মীদের উৎসাহিত করবেন এবং আপনি নিজেও তৎপর থাকবেন। সমিতির প্রতি সদস্যর বাড়ি সরেজমিনে পরিদর্শন এবং সদস্যদের সাথে সম্পর্ক উন্নয়ন করা। অনুরূপ দায়িত্ব পালন প্রতি মাঠ ব্যবস্থাপকের জন্য বাধ্যতামূলক। প্রতিটি প্রকল্প সরেজমিনে সম্ভাব্যতা যাচাই নিশ্চিতকরণ। সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্মী ও সমিতির সমস্ত সদস্যদের উপস্থিতিতে সমিতির সভায় প্রকল্প প্রাথমিকভাবে অনুমোদনের রেজুলেশন নিশ্চিতকরণ। দ্বিতীয় পর্যায়ে কর্মী সমন্বয় সভায় সকলের উপস্থিতিতে প্রকল্প অনুমোদনের রেজুলেশন নিশ্চিতকরণ।  ঋণগ্রহীতা সদস্যকে ঋণ গ্রহন, ফেরত এবং ঋণের অর্থ প্রকল্পে বিনিয়োগ ইত্যাদি বিষয় স্বচ্ছ ধারণা বিষয়ে নিশ্চিতকরণ।  প্রকল্পে ঋণ গ্রহনের ক্ষেত্রে ঋণ গ্রহীতার পক্ষে জামিনদারের দায়বদ্ধতার বিষয়ে স্বচ্ছ ধারণা নিশ্চিতকরণ।  এরিয়া ম্যানেজারের সাথে পরামর্শ ও সহায়তা নিয়ে ঋণ কর্মসূচীর সমস্ত বিষয়ে পরিচালনা ও বাস্তবায়ন করবেন।  এছাড়াও বিশেষ বিশেষ সময় সংস্থা কর্তৃক অর্পিত অন্যান্য দায়িত্ব পালন করবেন।

job_description: Organization Introduction: SARPV, a non-profit organization dedicated to empowering underprivileged communities and providing social Support since 1988, is partnering with PKSF to implement the "Resilient Homestead and Livelihood Support to the Vulnerable Coastal People of Bangladesh (RHL)" project. Running from September 2023, UN Green Climate Fund-backed initiative addresses the severe climate vulnerabilities faced by Bangladesh’s coastal populations. Residents in these low-lying zones suffer from climate-sensitive incomes, scarce drinking water, and fragile mud housing that creates a poverty trap through frequent, costly storm repairs. To build climate-adaptive communities, the RHL project introduces resilient housing and sustainable livelihood technologies across seven vulnerable districts, including Cox's Bazar. As an implementing entity for the project, SARPV will execute these initiatives locally in Chakaria, Cox’s Bazar. To support this mission and drive grassroots development, SARPV's Project Management Unit is currently seeking qualified candidates for the position of Community Mobilization Officer (CMO) to foster community resilience and create lasting positive change. Key Responsibilities: Project beneficiary selection and preparation of beneficiary socio-economic profile. Identify and engage key community members to establish Climate Change Adaptation Groups (CCAGs) in assigned communities. Facilitate monthly meetings of the CCAGs, ensuring active participation and discussion of climate change challenges, adaptation strategies, and project activities. Empower the CCAG to play a lead role in community mobilization and decision-making related to project implementation. Organize and conduct awareness campaigns and training sessions on climate change impacts, coastal disaster & salinity adaptation & mitigation strategies, and sustainable practices. Work with the CCAGs to identify beneficiaries and participants for various project activities like Agriculture, Livestock, crab culture, rainwater harvesting, climate resilient housing etc. Provide on-site guidance and support to community members during activity implementation. Promote the adoption of climate-smart practices and sustainable livelihoods within the community. Rapport build-up with local government and community leaders. Encourage positive behavioral change toward water conservation, responsible waste management, and other adaptation strategies. Assist with collecting data on community demographics, livelihoods, climate perceptions, and project impacts. Prepare regular reports on community engagement activities, awareness campaigns, and beneficiary selection processes. Liaise with the Technical Officers and Project Coordinator to ensure efficient data sharing and reporting. Perform any other duties assigned by PKSF & IE Management. job_description: দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য: অংকুর ঋণ হিসাব ব্যবস্থাপনা ম্যানুয়াল”অনুযায়ী মাঠে সমিতি গঠন ও পরিচালনা করা। যেমন - সমিতির সাপ্তাহিক সভার আয়োজন করা, সঞ্চয় ও ঋণ পাশ বই এবং সভার মন্তব্য বই লেখা। সংগঠিত সমিতির মাঝে সংস্থা কর্তৃক গৃহিত কর্মসূচী বাস্তবায়ন করা। যেমন- প্রশিক্ষণ, সামাজিক বনায়ন, ঋণ বিতরণ, প্রাথমিক স্বাস্থ্য শিক্ষা, শিক্ষা, নারী সমাজ ও উন্নয়ন এবং আর্সেনিক নিরাময় ইত্যাদি। বাৎসরিক, মাসিক ও সাপ্তাহিক ঋণ বিতরণ পরিকল্পনা তৈরি করা। সমিতির সদস্যদের ঋণ আবেদন ফরম পূরণ করে ঋণ বিতরণের কমপক্ষে ১ সপ্তাহ পূর্বে শাখা ব্যবস্থাপকের নিকট দাখিল করা এবং ঋণ বিতরণের জন্য সুপারিশ করা। দৈনিক সভার আয়োজন করা এবং বকেয়া কিস্তি আদায়ে পদক্ষেপ গ্রহণ। দৈনিক কমপক্ষে ৩ টি সমিতির ঋণের কিস্তি আদায় করা ও সভা পরিচালনা করা। সমিতি থেকে আদায়কৃত সঞ্চয় ও ঋণের কিস্তি নিয়মিত অফিসে জমা দেয়া এবং দৈনিক ঋণ ও সঞ্চয় রেজিষ্ট্রার -এ এন্ট্রিসহ দৈনিক কাজ সম্পন্ন করা। সংস্থা ব্যবহৃত সফট্ওয়্যারে প্রতিদিনের লেনদেন প্রতিদিন নির্ভুলভাবে হালনাগাদ করা। সমিতির অন্যান্য সদস্যদের সহায়তা নিয়ে বকেয়া সদস্যার উপর চাপ সৃষ্টি করে তাৎক্ষণিক আদায়ের ব্যবস্থা নেয়া। এছাড়া কোন সহকর্মীর সমিতিতে খেলাপী হলে টিম আকারে সেখানে গিয়ে আদায়ের ব্যবস্থা নেয়া। বছরের ডিসেম্বর ও জুন প্রান্তিকে সদস্য ভিত্তিক সঞ্চয়ের উপর সফট্ওয়্যারে হিসাবায়িত মুনাফা সদস্যদের পাশ বইয়ে এন্ট্রি দেয়া। সঞ্চয় ও ঋণের কিস্তি এবং যেকোন লেনদেন পাশবইতে না লিখে সমিতির সদস্যদের নিকট হতে গ্রহন করা যাবে না। সংস্থা ও ঋণ আবেদনকারী সদস্য’র মধ্যে সম্পাদিতব্য ঋণ চুক্তির শর্তাবলী ঋণ আবেদনকারীকে বিস্তারিতভাবে বুঝানো এবং ঋণ চুক্তিতে জামিনদারের দায় সম্পর্কে সবিস্তারে অবহিত করে স্বাক্ষর গ্রহন করা। আপনি আপনার দায়িত্ব কর্তব্য পালনের জন্য শাখা ব্যবস্থাপকের নিকট দায়ী থাকবেন। এ ছাড়াও সংস্থা কর্তৃক অর্পিত অন্যান্য দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য পালন করা।

job_description: About DTech Corporation Limited DTech Corporation Limited  is one of Bangladesh’s largest and most established façade engineering, fabrication, and installation companies. With over 30 years of industry experience and more than 300 successfully completed projects, DTech has built a strong reputation for delivering high-quality and innovative façade solutions for commercial, residential, industrial, institutional, and government developments. Our expertise includes curtain wall systems, structural glazing, ACP cladding, aluminum doors and windows, skylights, glass domes, canopies, spider glazing, architectural metalwork, and other customized building-envelope solutions. Position Summary DTech Corporation Limited  is seeking a highly experienced and technically capable Project Manager – Façade Engineering & Projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting and managing façade projects from system design and structural analysis through procurement, fabrication, installation, quality control, and final handover. The candidate will also oversee vendor coordination, labor management, project-level human resources activities, and quality-control operations across all projects of the company. Extensive practical experience in the façade industry is mandatory. Preference will be given to candidates with strong experience in façade system design, structural analysis, project execution, workforce supervision, and quality assurance. Key Responsibilities Project Management and Coordination Assist the Project Engineers in planning, executing, monitoring, and completing multiple façade projects. Prepare and monitor project schedules, work programs, budgets, manpower plans, procurement schedules, and resource allocations. Coordinate with clients, consultants, architects, structural engineers, main contractors, subcontractors, and internal departments. Conduct regular project meetings, site inspections, and progress reviews. Prepare progress reports, technical submissions, method statements, meeting minutes, variation documents, and project handover records. Identify project risks, delays, technical challenges, and resource shortages and implement corrective measures. Ensure projects are completed safely, within budget, according to specification, and within the approved timeframe. Façade System Design and Engineering The candidate must have the full technical capability to independently design, develop, detail, and coordinate façade systems, including: Stick Curtain Wall Systems Semi-Unitized Curtain Wall Systems Unitized Curtain Wall Systems General Sliding Systems Euro Sliding Systems Folding and Bifold Door Systems Structural Glazing Systems Spider Glazing Systems ACP Cladding Systems Glass Canopies Glass Domes Skylights Aluminum Doors and Windows Louvers Architectural Metalwork Customized Façade and Building-Envelope Systems The candidate will be expected to: Develop façade system concepts and technical details. Prepare and review shop drawings, fabrication drawings, cutting lists, and installation drawings. Review architectural, structural, and MEP drawings for coordination. Prepare material take-offs, BOQs, and technical specifications. Coordinate design submissions and approvals with consultants and clients. Resolve technical, fabrication, and site-related design issues. Review system performance requirements, including wind load, deflection, water tightness, air tightness, thermal movement, and structural stability. Façade Structural Analysis Conduct or supervise structural analysis of façade systems and components. Perform calculations for wind pressure, structural loads, glass thickness, mullions, transoms, brackets, anchors, fasteners, and supporting members. Check deflection, stress, load transfer, and structural adequacy of façade components. Prepare or review structural calculation reports for consultant approval. Coordinate with structural engineers and testing agencies where required. Ensure all façade systems comply with applicable international codes, project specifications, and safety requirements. Preference will be given to candidates with proven hands-on experience using façade structural-analysis software or engineering calculation tools. Vendor and Procurement Management Identify, evaluate, appoint, and manage local and international vendors, suppliers, fabricators, and subcontractors. Obtain and compare technical and commercial quotations. Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, payment terms, warranties, and technical requirements. Ensure purchased materials comply with approved specifications, samples, and quality standards. Monitor supplier performance, material lead times, production status, and delivery schedules. Coordinate procurement activities with project schedules and site requirements. Maintain strong professional relationships with key suppliers and subcontractors. Address vendor-related quality, delivery, and contractual issues. Quality Control and Quality Assurance The Deputy Project Manager will oversee quality-control activities for all company projects and will be responsible for ensuring consistent standards from material procurement through project handover. Establishing and implementing project-specific QA/QC procedures. Inspecting incoming materials, aluminum profiles, glass, panels, accessories, sealants, hardware, and fasteners. Monitoring fabrication quality in the factory and installation quality at project sites. Ensuring all work complies with approved shop drawings, method statements, specifications, and samples. Preparing inspection checklists, inspection requests, quality reports, non-conformance reports, and corrective-action records. Coordinating mock-ups, performance tests, water tests, and other required façade testing. Conducting regular factory and site quality audits. Managing snagging, rectification, final inspection, and project handover. Training engineers, supervisors, technicians, and installers on quality requirements. Maintaining company-wide quality standards across all active projects. Labor and Workforce Management Plan and manage labor requirements for all projects. Allocate workers, technicians, installers, supervisors, and subcontractor teams according to project needs. Monitor labor attendance, productivity, discipline, performance, and efficiency. Ensure proper deployment of skilled and unskilled labor across project sites. Coordinate mobilization, transfer, accommodation, transportation, and demobilization of project labor where necessary. Resolve labor-related disputes, operational issues, and disciplinary matters. Ensure workers comply with company policies, safety procedures, quality requirements, and site regulations. Monitor subcontractor manpower and productivity. Coordinate training and skill development for installation and fabrication teams. Maintain accurate labor records, deployment plans, performance reports, and productivity data. Human Resources Responsibilities In addition to project responsibilities, the candidate will support selected HR functions related to technical and project personnel. Assist in recruiting engineers, supervisors, technicians, draftsmen, fabricators, installers, and project staff. Participate in interviews, technical assessments, and candidate evaluations. Support employee onboarding, orientation, deployment, and probation reviews. Assess staff performance and recommend confirmation, promotion, training, transfer, or disciplinary action. Ensure all projects follow health, safety, and environmental requirements.

job_description: Job Nature:   Full-time (Contractual Up to December 2026, Might be Extended Upon Project Renewal) Project Brief:   Since 2022, the organization has been implementing a vocational skill development program for Rohingya Refugees in Cox`s Bazar and Bhasan Char. The program, known as the UN Joint Programme for Skills Development (JPSD) or Improving Skills and Economic Opportunities in Cox`s Bazar (ISEC), aims to provide vocational training and improve economic prospects for the beneficiaries. The organization is responsible for delivering Level-1 vocational training in various fields including Concreter (CON), Solar (PV) System Installation and Maintenance (SM), Caregiving (CG), Small Engine Mechanic (SEM) and Bakery and Pastry Staff (BPS). Beneficiaries are selected based on prequalification criteria that consider the labor market needs in Myanmar and the camps. The project`s main objective is to empower refugees by equipping them with transferable skills that meet labor market demands in both Myanmar and the camp settings. This will support their potential return and integration into Myanmar and enable them to have productive lives in the camps. To achieve this, refugees are encouraged to engage in activities such as multi-sector endeavors, minor livelihood pursuits, community works, and utilizing their acquired skills. The Economic Mobility Pathways Pilot (EMPP) Programme has been launched during the last quarter of 2023, then the it was known as Complementary Pathways Programme (CPP), which become known as the Language and ICT Training, aims to enhance labor mobility and empowerment of Rohingya refugee graduates who successfully complete the Level-1 certification course. According to the plan of UNHCR, competent graduates from all trades carefully selected through a rigorous and holistic assessment process will get the opportunity to get this additional course support from 2024. The initiative focuses on providing additional life skills training, including English language proficiency, `work ready` cultural orientation, and fundamental ICT skills. The project overall aims to improve employability, increase labor mobility, and promote economic empowerment among Rohingya graduates.    Part I: Job Statement The Assistant Trainer (AT) will be responsible for contributing towards the Competency Standard (CS) and Competency Based Learning Materials (CBLM) development and delivery of different skill development vocational programs under the project for the targeted beneficiaries at camp level. AT will be responsible to assist the Vocational Training Specialist (VTS) for overseeing and coordinating different trades selected, based on the curriculum provided by UNHCR and ensure support to implement the activities in the refugee camps where designated training centers are established by UNHCR. S/he will ensure timely delivery of the vocational course(s) and the successful completion through external assessment followed by certification, following the humanitarian principles and sector guidelines and standard. S/he will closely work with the Vocational Training Expert (VTE) and VTS to implement the training curriculum for the assessment-based trade for the refugee beneficiaries and will facilitate them to engage with self & wage employment during/ after receiving the vocational training from the project. S/he will also provide technical guidance to the Vocational Supervisor (VS). S/he will perform his/her task with close collaboration and under the supervision of Vocational Training Specialist (VTS). The project is seeking an Assistant Trainer (AT) at present who will be responsible for delivering the Myanmar Level-1 curriculum for the Caregiving (CG) trade.   Part II: Job Responsibilities and Tasks A. Key Activities: To conduct the selection and enrolment process of training participants to a specific trade ensuring the prequalification criteria with the assistance of Senior Officer-Job Placement (SO-JP), Officer-Skills (O-S) and VTS. To implement all vocational education & training with the help of VTS, and KOBO management operation of the project with the support of Senior Monitoring & Evaluation Officer (SMEO). Ashshash: For Men And Women Who Have Escaped Trafficking Phase-II is a project of WINROCK International which is implemented by Caritas Bangladesh through a partnership agreement in Khulna district. The Ashshash (Phase-II) is funded by the Embassy of Switzerland in Bangladesh through WINROCK International. Project aims to restore the dignity and well-being and become self-sufficient of human trafficking survivors. After identification and profiling the survivors get the emergency supports including health, legal, psychosocial counselling support along with other social services and facilitated opportunities for skill-development and entrepreneurship training. Upon completion of the training survivors are to be placed in either wage-based and or self-employment. Furthermore, Ashshash will reach people in the project`s working areas; either directly or indirectly, through awareness-raising activities on factors that make people vulnerable to human trafficking, and to ensure the prevention of human trafficking. Project is also execute a intensive follow-up and monitoring to a intensive monitoring and evaluation framework with online and offline data management and analysis to report generation. Prepare regular process monitoring reports, periodic performance reports, dashboards, and other analytical reports. Conduct trend and performance analysis using monitoring data to support project reporting, adaptive management, and evidence-based decision-making. Support the Project Manager in preparing, reviewing, and finalizing donor and organizational reports. Conduct regular field monitoring visits to assess implementation quality, verify data, identify gaps, and provide constructive feedback for program improvement. Provide technical support in conducting baseline, endline, assessments, evaluations, research studies, and periodic Data Quality Assessments (DQA). Ensure effective implementation of beneficiary accountability, complaints, and feedback-response mechanisms in accordance with the project`s Accountability Framework. Manage the Ashshash Management Information System (MIS) and ensure timely, accurate, and complete data entry in line with the MEL Plan and Data Flow Diagram. Analyze project data, generate performance insights, and provide actionable recommendations to improve project implementation and results. Document success stories, case studies, lessons learned, best practices, and project achievements in collaboration with project staff and under the technical guidance of Winrock International. Ensure proper SRH data recording in the IRC-supported health facilities, support the compilation of data and generation of quality SRH reports in a regular and timely manner to ensure all required donor reports are completed on time and to a high standard. Work closely with the Senior Managers for implementing strategies to increase Family Planning (FP) uptake with a special focus on community awareness raising and ensuring the availability of FP supplies in IRC-supported facilities. With the support of Senior Managers implement training to build capacity on BEmONC and other SRH services for IRC health facility staff. Develop awareness-raising messages with other colleagues to promote the uptake of emergency SRH services in a timely manner. Undertake regular field monitoring visits to assess progress and support in technical issues and/or other implementation issues. Directly provide LARC services in the WSSs and other health facilities. Work closely with the IRC’s Women Protection & Empowerment (WPE) teams to implement holistic programming to meet the diverse and unique needs of women and girls; Promote a culture of learning whereby lessons-learned and good practices are documented and shared for institutional memory. job_description: Job Nature:  Full-time (Contractual Up to December 2026, Might be Extended Upon Project Renewal) Project Brief:   Since 2022, under the technical guidance of UNHCR’s Livelihoods Unit, the Centre for Natural Resource Studies (CNRS) has been implementing comprehensive livelihoods and vocational skills development interventions for Rohingya refugees in Cox’s Bazar and Bhasan Char. As part of the UN Joint Programme for Skills Development (JPSD), also known as Improving Skills and Economic Opportunities in Cox’s Bazar (ISEC), CNRS delivers Level-1 vocational training aimed at enhancing employability and economic resilience among refugees. The vocational training component focuses on transferable, market-relevant skills aligned with labor market needs in both Myanmar and the refugee camp context. Training is provided in multiple trades, including Concreter (CON), Solar (PV) System Installation and Maintenance (SM), Caregiving (CG), Small Engine Mechanic (SEM), and Bakery and Pastry Staff (BPS). Beneficiaries are selected through a prequalification process that considers labor market demand, skill applicability, and individual suitability. The overall objective is to empower refugees with practical skills that support productive engagement within the camps and prepare them for potential return and reintegration into Myanmar. Complementing vocational training, CNRS also implements livelihoods interventions through multiple production centers—such as eco-friendly bag, reusable sanitary pad, apparel, and other income-generating units—where refugee women, particularly from female-headed households, participate in skill development and dignified work opportunities. These centers play a vital role in strengthening household well-being, enhancing economic self-reliance, and promoting community resilience. To further enhance labor mobility and employability, the Economic Mobility Pathways Pilot (EMPP) Programme—previously known as the Complementary Pathways Programme (CPP) and now implemented as Language and ICT Training—was introduced in late 2023. From 2024 onward, selected competent graduates from Level-1 vocational training receives additional support through English language training, work-readiness and cultural orientation, and basic ICT skills, based on a rigorous and holistic assessment process led by UNHCR. The project overall aims to improve employability, increase labor mobility, and promote economic empowerment among Rohingya graduates. Part I: Job Statement The Storekeeper is responsible for the proper receipt, storage, and issuance of raw materials, machineries and finished products within the production centers. The primary objective of this position is to maintain accurate inventory records, ensure materials are stored safely and securely, and support timely distribution to production teams as required. The incumbent will coordinate closely with the Warehouse In-Charge, production teams, and project management to track inventory levels, manage stock rotation, and maintain documentation. By ensuring efficient and accountable store operations, the Storekeeper contributes directly to the smooth functioning and effectiveness of the Project. Part II: Job Responsibilities and Tasks A. Key Activities: Receive, inspect, and verify incoming materials, supplies and finished products against delivery notes and purchase orders. Organize, store, and maintain materials, tools and finished products in an orderly and secure manner. Issue and maintain proper documentation such as Challan/Waybill, GRN, Requisition Forms, Stock Cards, BIN Cards etc. Maintain accurate inventory records, including stock registers, issue/receive logs, and electronic records if applicable. Issue materials and tools to production teams based on approved requests, ensuring proper documentation. Monitor stock levels and notify supervisors when replenishment or procurement is needed. Ensure proper handling, storage, and rotation of materials to prevent damage, spoilage, or loss. Conduct periodic physical counts and reconciliations to verify stock accuracy. Maintain cleanliness, orderliness, and safety within the storage area according to CNRS and UNHCR standards. Prepare reports on stock status, discrepancies, and material usage for management review. Assist in inventory audits and follow up on corrective actions for any discrepancies. Coordinate with production teams, Warehouse In-Charge, and project management to ensure smooth material flow. Adherent to safety and security protocols for storage and handling of materials and equipment. B. Core Competencies (Knowledge, Ability & Attitude): Strong organizational skills to maintain orderly storage and systematic inventory management. Attention to detail to ensure accurate recording, tracking, and issuance of materials. Knowledge of inventory management practices, stock rotation, and material handling procedures. Computer skills for maintaining electronic stock records and preparing reports. Ability to communicate effectively with production teams, warehouse staff, and supervisors. Reliability, integrity, and accountability in handling materials and maintaining stock security. Time-management skills to prioritize tasks and ensure timely distribution of materials. Awareness of safety, security, and hygiene standards in storage areas. Ability to perform periodic physical counts and reconcile discrepancies efficiently. Proactive approach to identifying stock shortages or potential issues and notifying relevant staff. Teamwork and collaboration skills to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in production and warehouse management.

job_description: WARBE Development Foundation:  WARBE Development Foundation is a non-profit organization working in the field of migration and development in Bangladesh since 1997. WARBE took the pioneering role in Bangladesh as a migrant workers’ association to deal with the issues of migrants’ rights. WARBE has undertaken many development activities at the grassroots and national and international levels to protect the rights, well-being and dignity of migrant workers and their families. As part of this, WARBE DF with support from the Winrock International is implementing the Ashshash (Phase–II) in Dhaka East and Narsingdi which is funded by the Embassy of Switzerland in Bangladesh. PROJECT BACKGROUND: Winrock International – Ashshash (Phase–II), is funded by the Embassy of Switzerland in Bangladesh. The project is supporting human trafficking survivors with sustainable social and economic reintegration into their respective communities, and also providing support-services that ensures their wellbeing and self-sufficiency. The survivors are getting psychosocial counseling support along with other social services, and facilitated opportunities for skills-devolvement and entrepreneurship training. Through which, the economic empowerment of the survivors is also ensured in the forms of wage-based and self-employment, and other income generation opportunities. The main objective of the project is to ensure that “women and men who have escaped trafficking will restore their dignity and wellbeing, and become self-sufficient”. Furthermore, Ashshash will reach people in the project’s working areas; either directly or indirectly, through awareness-raising activities on factors that make people vulnerable to human trafficking, and to ensure the prevention of human trafficking. The Ashshash project is providing comprehensive and personalized packages of service-provision to the survivors of human trafficking in Bangladesh. The project is implemented in ten of the most trafficking-prone areas across the country. POSITION SUMMARY: Project Manager (PM) will work under the direct oversight of WARBE (Ashshash’s Sustainable Reintegration Partner (SRP) across the working districts of Dhaka East & Narsingdi of the project. The PM will work as lead of the Ashshash project at WARBE DF. Leading and managing project activities to ensure their overall sustainable reintegration by building and maintaining a collaborative and interpersonal relationship with service providers will plan and manage the case management process for the survivors. PM will lead the assessment process of contextual needs and demands of each survivor under their management. Through this process, the PMs will identify and plan the provision of relevant psychosocial and social services, career-oriented choices for the economic development of the survivors through training and employment opportunities based on their contextual requirements, in a customized modality. Accordingly, the PMs will demonstrate the advocacy initiatives with the government offices. Also create a strong and effective collaboration and to support National Referral Mechanism (NRM) with local public and private service providers and avail the required services for each survivor. The PMs are also expected to demonstrate ethical engagement and care with the survivors, gender-sensitive methodologies of communication and guidance, and how to provide of trauma-informed support to the survivors. The PMs must also ensure compliance with WARBE and Winrock International’s ‘Code of Conduct’ and ‘Do No Harm Policy’, whilst maintaining privacy and confidentiality of information respective to each survivor. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Lead a Project team and provide professional and technical support to project staff and other stakeholders of Ashshash project; Overall management of project implementation and activities based on the operational plan to achieve project target in time; Ensure that project activities are implemented in time complying with donor requirements; Day-to-day supervise and monitor the activities of project team including social services, economic empowerment, finance and monitoring to ensure effective project implementation; Coordinate the overall case management (identification to reintegration) system of Ashshash; Ensure social protection services to each survivor through need assessment, psychosocial counselling, health and legal support; Secure economic empowerment support to each survivor through comprehensive career counselling, soft skills, skills development, assessment, certification, entrepreneurship training, employment including Wage and Self with follow-up support; Ensure private sector engagement through partnership for sustainable wage and self-employment of the Ashshash beneficiaries; Coordination with other government and non-government service providing organizations to ensure service through referral; job_description: Transparency International Bangladesh (TIB) is inviting applications from Bangladeshi nationals for the position of Research Associate (RA) to be recruited for a project titled  Strengthening Banking Sector Integrity in Bangladesh (BSI).  The Research Associate (BSI) is expected to join in August-September 2026 and serve until June 2027, renewable subject to extension of the project and mutual agreement. The incumbent will be based in Dhaka, subject to field work anywhere in Bangladesh.  Project objective in brief:  The project aims to address major governance weaknesses in the banking sector, including weak regulatory enforcement and oversight, anti-money-laundering regime, and recovery of non-performing loans. These challenges contribute to illicit financial flows and weakened public trust in the banking sector of Bangladesh. The project combines research and evidence-based policy advocacy to assess integrity risks in regulatory compliance, prevention of illicit financial flows, and loan recovery. placing orders in time. ছোটখাটো মেরামতের জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় ভোগ্যপণ্য ও উপকরণের পর্যাপ্ত মজুদ নিশ্চিত করা এবং সময়মতো অর্ডার প্রদানসহ মজুদ ব্যবস্থাপনা করা। Keep all documents related to installations / equipment / infrastructures in order and update them regularly. স্থাপনা/সরঞ্জাম/অবকাঠামো সম্পর্কিত সকল নথিপত্র সুশৃঙ্খলভাবে সংরক্ষণ করা এবং নিয়মিত হালনাগাদ করা। Immediately inform the line manager of any problems that arise in the course of the work, particularly with regard to damage, loss, theft or attempted break-ins. কাজের সময় উদ্ভূত যেকোনো সমস্যা, বিশেষ করে ক্ষতি, হারিয়ে যাওয়া, চুরি বা চুরির চেষ্টা সংক্রান্ত বিষয় অবিলম্বে লাইন ম্যানেজারকে জানানো। Assist logistics department for any related work needed. প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সংশ্লিষ্ট কাজে লজিস্টিকস বিভাগকে সহায়তা করা। MSF Section/Context Specific Accountabilities: এমএসএফ সেকশন/প্রেক্ষাপটভিত্তিক নির্দিষ্ট দায়িত্বসমূহ: Carrying out critical rehabilitation tasks. Including the corrective maintenance interventions and the coordination/execution of required tasks and installation of needed electrical equipment defined by each project. গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পুনর্বাসনমূলক কাজ সম্পাদন করা, যার মধ্যে সংশোধনমূলক রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ কার্যক্রম এবং প্রতিটি প্রকল্প অনুযায়ী প্রয়োজনীয় কাজ ও বৈদ্যুতিক সরঞ্জাম স্থাপনের সমন্বয়/বাস্তবায়ন অন্তর্ভুক্ত। Carrying out and updating the electrical installations inventory in MSF missions’ facilities and performing annual maintenance procedures/safety checks across facilities in the project. Executing any needed tests after any repair or maintenance. এমএসএফ মিশনের স্থাপনাগুলোর বৈদ্যুতিক সরঞ্জামের ইনভেন্টরি প্রস্তুত ও হালনাগাদ করা এবং প্রকল্পের সকল স্থাপনায় বার্ষিক রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ ও নিরাপত্তা পরীক্ষা সম্পন্ন করা। যেকোনো মেরামত বা রক্ষণাবেক্ষণের পর প্রয়োজনীয় পরীক্ষা সম্পাদন করা। Responsible for the equipment and tools (including extinguishers), checking they are correctly and safely used, maintaining and renewing them when necessary, and keeping the inventory updated. সরঞ্জাম ও যন্ত্রপাতির (অগ্নিনির্বাপক যন্ত্রসহ) দায়িত্ব গ্রহণ করা, সেগুলো নিরাপদ ও সঠিকভাবে ব্যবহার হচ্ছে কিনা নিশ্চিত করা, প্রয়োজনে রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ ও প্রতিস্থাপন করা এবং ইনভেন্টরি হালনাগাদ রাখা। Ensure to check out the generator fuel level and maintain cleanliness based on a standard policy, responsible to maintain generator log book daily. নির্ধারিত নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী জেনারেটরের জ্বালানির পরিমাণ পরীক্ষা ও পরিচ্ছন্নতা বজায় রাখা এবং প্রতিদিন জেনারেটর লগবুক সংরক্ষণ করা। Ensure preventive and corrective maintenance on the biomedical devices as supervisor direction accordingly. সুপারভাইজারের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী বায়োমেডিক্যাল যন্ত্রপাতির প্রতিরোধমূলক ও সংশোধনমূলক রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ নিশ্চিত করা। Preparing 1% chlorine solution and checking free residual chlorine (FRC) level at water daily. ১% ক্লোরিন দ্রবণ প্রস্তুত করা এবং প্রতিদিন পানিতে ফ্রি রেসিডুয়াল ক্লোরিন (FRC) এর মাত্রা পরীক্ষা করা। Working in close collaboration with the different professionals involved in the construction in order to respond to their needs (material supplies, manpower needs, etc.) নির্মাণকাজে জড়িত বিভিন্ন পেশাজীবীদের সাথে ঘনিষ্ঠভাবে কাজ করা যাতে তাদের প্রয়োজন (উপকরণ সরবরাহ, জনবল প্রয়োজন ইত্যাদি) পূরণ করা যায়। Ensuring that all record sheets and books related to maintenance are always completed and preparing needed reports before and after any repair or required maintenance. রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ সম্পর্কিত সকল রেকর্ড শিট ও বই যথাযথভাবে পূরণ করা এবং যেকোনো মেরামত বা রক্ষণাবেক্ষণের আগে ও পরে প্রয়োজনীয় প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করা। Keeping the working area clean and tidy. কর্মস্থল পরিষ্কার ও পরিপাটি রাখা। Looking after tools and materials, carrying out periodic inventories with the workers, and ensuring the renewal of tools and/or materials if necessary. সরঞ্জাম ও উপকরণের যত্ন নেওয়া, কর্মীদের সাথে নিয়মিত ইনভেন্টরি সম্পন্ন করা এবং প্রয়োজন হলে সরঞ্জাম ও/অথবা উপকরণ প্রতিস্থাপন নিশ্চিত করা।

job_description: Supervising the daily logistics activities and providing maintenance to the MSF equipment, facilities and infrastructures, according to MSF standards and protocols in order to maintain the facilities in perfect conditions and collaborate in the development of the mission. MSF Section/Context Specific Accountabilities Monitoring maintenance activities of infrastructures, management of non-medical stocks and equipment according to MSF standards Ensuring the check and follow-up of facilities under the line manager's supervision through daily visits to the facilities and reporting any anomalies or problems, evaluation of the rehabilitation needs and following up minor building rehabilitation work according to supervisor's instructions; checking that premises observe security norms and monitoring the consumption of mechanical and electrical vehicles/machines/devices Planning together with the line manager the required checks and maintenance activities of energy systems/set-up according to MSF standards Coordinating and leading the logistics team under his/her responsibility which includes daily supervision, monitoring of the quality of work and the definition of each person's task, drawing up their working schedules; organizing and leading team meetings; participating in the recruitment of team personnel and attending logistics meetings and accounting for his activities Ensuring the vehicle fleet maintenance which includes planning and overseeing timely preventive and curative maintenance of all project vehicles according to MSF standards and Instructing and monitoring drivers on correct driving habits and standard checks Managing and following up orders which includes collecting logistics orders coming from different departments or health facilities; drawing up and following up orders according to the procedures in force; providing technical support to the storekeeper, makes local purchases according to MSF supply procedures and ensures reception conditions of freight or arriving material as well as the organization and setting up of materials before its shipment Facility management Supervising the daily logistical construction activities, providing upgrades to MSF equipment, facilities and infrastructures, according to MSF standards and protocols in order to maintain the facilities in perfect condi-tions. As Technical logistics supervisor, function as focal point for executing technical/construction projects as de-scribed in the logistic annex/budget with support of the Hospital Facility Manager Assess, develop and organize tenders for outside contractors and supply team, incl. BoQ Supervise and organize work in the Hospital with both outside contractors and internal maintenance team Develop design drawings and/or sketches for construction projects Collaborate with hospital medical team to facilitate smooth implementation of construction projects. Assist oversee preventive and corrective maintenance of hospital infrastructure, including building, HVAC, electrical systems, and energy setup, ensuring optimal functionality in support of the Hospital logistics su-pervisor Manage facility upkeep, including smooth, washable surfaces, signage for effective patient flow, and promptly repairing any damage to walls, floors, and partitions. Assist Line manager in identifying and escalating budget needs for future renovation, rehabilitation, and maintenance and small-scale construction projects as described in budget. Applied Security Contribute to contingency planning for security threats and operational disruptions, and conduct risk as-sessments (e.g., premises security, fire, energy) in the absence of Hospital logistics supervisor. Oversee the installation and maintenance of safety systems, such as smoke detectors, fire extinguishers, Security lighting and fencing. Act as backup security focal point, coordinating visitor access and liaising with the security team. Compile reports on security incidents, and mitigation measures for further reference and improvement in cooperation with Hospital logistics supervisor Supply Prepare internal requests and BoQ, assess needs, conduct feasibility analysis regarding internal technical construction projects and projects with external contractors. Manage communication between requestor and project supply team, oversee quality control, and ensure proper reception and delivery of items to requestors. General Administration and Team management Supervise and manage the team, including Base and Facilities Officer, Maintenance Agents and Head of Watchmen, ensuring smooth operations in the absence of Hospital Logistics supervisor. Develop and manage team schedules and rosters, handle leave requests, and ensure sufficient coverage in the absence of Hospital logistics supervisor Plan and delegate daily, weekly, and monthly tasks, while fostering team development through training and capacity-building initiatives in cooperation with Hospital logistics supervisor. Prepare and submit timely reports on team construction activities, progress, and challenges to Hospital Fa-cility Manager or management. Coordinate with other departments and ensure all activities comply with MSF policies and standards.

job_description: Carrying out surveillance and guarding activities in MSF facilities, according to MSF protocols and security rules, in order to ensure the safety and security of all mission's personnel and premises. এমএসএফ-এর নীতিমালা ও নিরাপত্তা বিধি অনুসরণ করে এমএসএফ স্থাপনায় নজরদারি ও প্রহরার দায়িত্ব পালন করা, যাতে মিশনের সকল কর্মী ও স্থাপনার নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিত করা যায়। MSF Section/Context Specific Accountabilities Surveying the MSF premise's access and guides people to reception within authorized hours. Contacts administration team for authorizing people access. অনুমোদিত সময়ের মধ্যে এমএসএফ প্রাঙ্গণে প্রবেশ নিয়ন্ত্রণ করা এবং আগত ব্যক্তিদের রিসেপশনে নির্দেশনা প্রদান করা। প্রয়োজনে প্রশাসন টিমের সাথে যোগাযোগ করে প্রবেশের অনুমতি নিশ্চিত করা। Watching MSF premises and property's perimeter fence through regular patrols. Remaining on duty until other watchman comes to do a handover, never leaving the post unattended. নিয়মিত টহলের মাধ্যমে এমএসএফ প্রাঙ্গণ ও সীমানা প্রাচীর পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। পরবর্তী ওয়াচম্যান দায়িত্ব গ্রহণ না করা পর্যন্ত কর্মস্থলে অবস্থান করা এবং কখনও পোস্ট ফাঁকা না রাখা। Organizing traffic of vehicles within the premises and directs them in and out. প্রাঙ্গণের ভেতরে যানবাহনের চলাচল নিয়ন্ত্রণ করা এবং সঠিকভাবে প্রবেশ ও বের হতে সহায়তা করা। Checking that the doors and windows are locked and lights are off when people leave premises. job_description: Background Friends In Village Development Bangladesh (FIVDB) is a Bangladeshi non-governmental organisation founded in 1979 under the Societies` Registration Act, 1860. The organisation is also registered with the NGO Affairs Bureau and the Micro Credit Regulatory Authority, of the Government of Bangladesh. The organisation`s societal vision is that of `a vibrant society based on justice, equity, democracy and environmentally sound principles`. It works with the mission to give the disadvantaged women, men and children greater voice, reduce their vulnerability, increase their use of citizenship rights and help them enhance their quality of life. FIVDB is implementing the `Recovery and Advancement of Informal Sector Employment (RAISE)` Project under the Additional Financing phase, implemented by the Palli Karma-Sahayak Foundation (PKSF) with support from the World Bank, aims to enhance employment opportunities, entrepreneurship development, and economic inclusion for low-income youth and microentrepreneurs. The project aims to enhance employment and income-generating opportunities for low-income youth through skills development, apprenticeship programs, entrepreneurship promotion, access to finance, and other livelihood support interventions. The project places particular emphasis on women, disadvantaged groups, and climate-vulnerable communities, thereby fostering inclusive economic growth and sustainable livelihoods across Bangladesh. The RAISE Project is being implemented nationwide through selected Partner Organizations (POs) of PKSF. As a Partner Organization of PKSF, FIVDB is responsible for implementing the project within its designated operational area in accordance with the project objectives and implementation guidelines. The duration of the Project is 4 years (up to June 2030). To ensure effective implementation of the project and achievement of its intended outcomes, FIVDB invites applications from qualified, experienced, and motivated professionals for  Training and Employment Support Officer (TESO)  position under the RAISE Project. The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) for the position are provided below. Key Responsibilities a) Training facilitation and capacity building Prepare a comprehensive training plan and conduct Life Skills, Business Management and Entrepreneurship Development (BMED), and Risk Management and Business Continuity (RMBC) training sessions in accordance with approved curricula, training manuals, and project guidelines. Prepare and deliver training sessions by developing session plans, training materials, presentations, handouts, and practical exercises, while facilitating interactive learning through participatory methods such as group discussions, case studies, role plays, simulations, and practical demonstrations to achieve effective learning outcomes. Ensure an inclusive, participatory, and learner-centered training environment that promotes active engagement and equal participation. Identify training gaps and recommend improvements to training content, methodologies, and delivery approaches. Prepare and submit training completion reports, participant performance summaries, and other required documentation in a timely manner. b) Career Preparation and Counseling Provide individual and group counseling during and after training. Help apprentices set career goals and plan accordingly. Conduct sessions on CV writing, interview preparation, workplace behavior, etc. Coordinate Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) certification where applicable. c) Employment and Entrepreneurship Support Implement training and capacity-building activities to strengthen project participants` business management, risk management, and business continuity competencies. Match graduates with job or self-employment opportunities. Guide apprentices on business startup and link them with financial and support services. Guide apprentices and Young Micro-entrepreneurs (YME) in developing business plans, financial literacy, and basic business management skills. d) Employer, Industry and Stakeholder Engagement Build partnerships and work intensively with MCPs, POs, local government, local employers and industries to create a supportive employment ecosystem for the apprentices. Formation and Functionalization of Employment Cells at the Field Level. Organize recruitment events, job fairs, and on-site interviews. e) Placement Tracking and Monitoring Keep records ofjob placements and follow up on job status and satisfaction. Maintain an updated database and track career progress of Apprentices, Young Micro-entrepreneurs. f) Reporting and Documentation Maintain project records, prepare regular progress reports, database and document success stories. Additional Responsibilities Support Community Outreach and Mobilization, especially for marginalized groups (e.g.Women, PwDs, ethnic minorities). Oversee enrollment, motivation, and mentoring of apprentices. Facilitate and access to entrepreneurship training, financing, and wider job markets. Promote gender equality, inclusion, and safeguarding in all activities. Support research and data collection like tracer studies and labor market assessments. Any other project-related responsibilities assigned by the management as required. Qualified women are strongly encouraged to apply.

করা হচ্ছে। প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ (Key Responsibilities): এন্টারপ্রাইজ এর আওতাভুক্ত সদস্যদের টেকসই, আয়বর্ধক কার্যক্রম ও ক্ষুদ্র উদ্যোগ গড়ে তুলতে সহায়তা করা। এন্টারপ্রাইজ অফিসার উদ্যোক্তা নির্বাচন, প্রশিক্ষণ এবং নিয়মিত ফলোআপের মাধ্যমে কর্মসূচীর সফল বাস্তবায়ন নিশ্চিত করা। স্থানীয় বাজার বা কর্ম এলাকায় সম্ভাবনাময় ক্ষুদ্র উদ্যোক্তাদের জরিপ করা। স্থানীয় বাজার বা কর্ম এলাকায় কর্মসূচী বাস্তবায়নের সুযোগ বিশ্লেষণ করা। সম্ভাবনাময় উদ্যোক্তা ও উদ্যোগ নির্বাচন এবং প্রয়োজনীয় আর্থিক ও সামাজিক মূল্যায়ন করা। নতুন ও বিদ্যমান উদ্যোগের সক্ষমতা বৃদ্ধি করা। মাঠ পরিদর্শনে সদস্যদের সাথে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও বিতরণকৃত খাতের অগ্রগতি পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। কর্মএলাকায় উদ্যোক্তাদের জন্য কোন প্রশিক্ষণের প্রয়োজন হলে তা সুপারভাইজারের সাথে আলোচনা ও অনুমোদন সাপেক্ষে তার আয়োজন করা। উদ্যোক্তাদের প্রশিক্ষণ প্রদান করা হলে প্রশিক্ষণ পরবর্তী অগ্রগতি ফলোআপ নিশ্চিত করা। সংস্থার এন্টারপ্রাইজ কর্মসূচীর নীতিমালা ও অন্যান্য প্রযোজ্য নীতিমালা অনুসরণ করে কর্মসূচী বাস্তবায়ন করা। চাহিদা মোতাবেক প্রয়োজনীয় অগ্রগতি প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করা। সদস্য পর্যায়ে সফলতার গল্প, কেস স্টাডি এবং ছবি সংগ্রহে সহায়তা করা। কর্ম এলাকায় অন্যান্য আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান, বাজার প্রতিনিধি এবং স্থানীয় গণ্যমান্য ব্যক্তিদের সাথে সমন্বয় বজায় রাখা। লিঙ্গ সমতা এবং মানবিক মূল্যবোধের প্রতি শ্রদ্ধাশীল থেকে নিয়মিত মাঠ পরিদর্শন করা। নির্ধারিত সংখ্যক সদস্য নির্বাচন ও প্রতিষ্ঠানের সক্ষমতা বৃদ্ধিতে ভূমিকা রাখা। ব্যবসায়ী/উদ্যোক্তাদের ব্যবসায়িক ঝুঁকি বিশ্লেষণ করে ঋণ বিতরণে সহযোগিতা করা। ব্যবসার নিবন্ধন, ট্রেড লাইসেন্স, টিন (TIN), ভ্যাট (VAT) এবং অন্যান্য আইনগত প্রক্রিয়া সম্পর্কে নিজে অবগত হয়ে ব্যবসায়ীদের পরামর্শ প্রদান করা। ঋণ আবেদন, ব্যবসায়িক আর্থিক পরিকল্পনা ও আর্থিক নথিপত্র প্রস্তুতিতে সুপারভাইজারকে সহযোগিতা করা। ব্যবসায়ী/উদ্যোক্তাদের সঞ্চয় প্রদানে উৎসাহ প্রদান করা। ২ লক্ষ টাকা হতে তদূর্ধ্ব সদস্য এবং কমপক্ষে ৩ কোটি টাকা ঋণস্থিতি পরিচালনা করা।

অবহিত করা। এলও ভিত্তিক প্রতিদিনের আদায়শিটের টাকা বুঝে নেওয়া, উক্ত টাকা ব্যাংকে জমা নিশ্চিত করা এবং সফটওয়্যারে পোস্টিং দেওয়া। ক্যাশ ও ব্যাংক সংক্রান্ত যাবতীয় দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা। বিল ও চুক্তিপত্র নবায়ন কার্যক্রমে বিএমকে সহযোগিতা করা। সরকারি নিয়মানুযায়ি ভ্যাট ও ট্যাক্স সংক্রান্ত যাবতীয় কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা এবং সকল রেজিস্টার হালনাগাদ রাখা ও যথাযথভাবে সংরক্ষণ করা। পিএফ, গ্রাচুইটি,
